required_presentational_changes.heading: Case 1 — what the PRRS-resistant-pig approval actually covers
required_presentational_changes.prior: FDA’s April 29, 2025 approval concerns deletion of exon 7 of CD163 in domestic pigs. The resistance indication applies to homozygous animals. The review describes controlled viral challenges and an assessment at 21 days, rather than a national farm-outcome survey. Importantly, the summary reports an exception for the KS06 strain; heterozygous and unedited pigs were not resistant in the studies. A headline saying that all edited pigs are immune to every PRRS virus would lose both the genetic and strain boundaries of the evidence.
required_presentational_changes.replacement: FDA’s April 29, 2025 approval concerns deletion of exon 7 of CD163 in domestic pigs. The resistance indication applies to homozygous animals.
